name: Sea-cliff path round the NE shoulder
purpose: A narrow, darker cliff-top path with surf below: a breath of compression and wind between the east terrace and the reveal of the lit suite cliff on the north side.

ceiling_profile.note: Open sky except an overhang of rock at y 95-105 on the north leg (2.8 m clear): the compressed passage before the north ledge reveal.

hero.outside_ok: Stands on a rock knob just beyond the railing at the path's outer corner, so the 3 m path stays clear.
hero.why: A tall cape lantern on the NE shoulder: visible from the east terrace as the single warm point against the sea, it is where the path turns north, so it pulls you along the whole first leg.

anchored.why: Cliff overhang above the inland half of the north leg (y 95-105): compression before the north ledge.
Pause at the turn, facing the sea stacks.

sightlines.see: The cape lantern at the end of the first leg, sea and sky to the right.
North up the leg: under the overhang, the white trickle falls and lit suite balconies stacked on the cliff.
The suite cliff opening up to the west.

concept.match: 32's front elevation seen from its east end at eye height: stacked lit suites, white trickles between them, lantern-lined balconies, sea stacks in mist to the right.

lights.why: Sparse posts on the sea-side railing: darker than the terraces either side.
Ankle niches in the inland rock, staggered against the posts.

mood.key: dark windy path to one warm lantern
mood.palette: blue-black sea, white surf, single amber cape lantern
mood.mist: sea spray drifting up the cliff

waivers.reason: Path is 3 m wide; the lantern stands on a rock knob outside the rail.
Deliberately dark between posts: contrast before the north ledge reveal.
